text:
Maya (Partnerships): QuasarCloud uploaded co-marketing zip and a short case blurb. Need quick QA: logo lockup, marketplace thumbnail sizes, quote release, and whether we can show the Quasar+Redwood hardware badge (they referenced "XPU Certified"). Can we review by EOD? @Carlos @Rina @Len
Carlos (Design): I'll validate logo vectors and make 1200x1200 + 1600x600 variants. They ask for partner-left / redwood-right lockup and a white-bg marketplace tile. Will add dark variant too.
Rina (Growth): Need short description (<=140 chars), alt text, and one-line quote we can feature. Asked PM for source of any metrics.
Len - Legal: Any third-party hardware badge requires written permission from the badge owner. Also need a signed testimonial release for the quote.
Maya (Partnerships): I'll request badge approval and signed release now. Deadline: partner aiming to publish next Thursday; we should lock assets by Tuesday noon.
AssetBot: Reminder: marketplace rules 2025-03 - thumbnails must have <2 logos and readable text at 400px. Safe text zone 90px.
Carlos (Design): Uploaded drafts to drive: https://drive.redwood/quasar/assets — included SVGs, PSD, and alt suggestions.
Rina (Growth): If badge approval isn't returned, we'll swap in a text mention "Compatible with XPU hardware". Will update thread when PM replies.
Len - Legal: I can clear the testimonial within 3 hours of receiving a signed pdf. Will flag if badge permission is missing.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks team. Tag any blockers here and we'll proceed with fallback if needed. :rocket:
